title: Predict: Enum Payloads & if case
hints: `if case` and `for case` match a single pattern without a full `switch`.
Only purchases add to `total`; the `for case` loop only visits purchases over 1000 cents.

jsBridge: `if case .loaded(let value) = state` is pattern matching outside a `switch`. The nearest JS equivalent is `if (state.kind === 'loaded') { const value = state.value }`, but Swift combines the check and the binding in one step.
